messages:
mira: Quick follow-up on the small manifest + tether approach I sketched yesterday — want consensus on operator idempotency before I lock the RFC.
jonathan: Can you summarize the tether idea in two lines for folks who skim?
mira: Sure. Instead of shipping full model blobs in the bundle we ship a tiny signed tether manifest that points at chunked assets. The operator pulls chunks lazily (networked fetch, seeded transfer, or USB sidecar). Activation is a separate, signed exchange with the control-plane. Goals: smaller bundles, cheaper diffs, safer activation boundaries.
alex: Distribution sounds good. My worry is partial-apply: operator dies after some chunks landed but before activation. Need a strong transactional model for stage/activate/rollback.
priya: Proposal: define three idempotent phases: PLAN (download+verify), STAGE (materialize staged-manifest + symlink staging), ACTIVATE (atomic switch + post-activate probes). Each phase reports an enum state: PENDING, STAGED, ACTIVATING, ACTIVATED, ROLLBACKING, ROLLED_BACK.
mira: Implementation sketch: control-plane mints a lease token per manifest. Operator downloads to tmp/<lease>/<chunk>, verifies checksums. On full verification write staged-manifest with lease token. Activation calls control-plane to obtain an activation_stamp (signed). Validate stamp locally then perform atomic swap.
jonathan: Lease expiry? We should avoid leaving orphaned partial data but also not kill slow transfers behind flaky links.
priya: Default lease TTL = 24h. Operator GC reclaims expired leases after an exponential backoff, but only for content not referenced by any staged-manifest. Expose a --grace-period flag for airgapped deployments that need longer retention.
alex: Two tricky scenarios: (A) operator binary upgrade while leases exist and (B) restart after activation stamp written but post-activate probes pending. For (A) include op_version in staged-manifest so newer operator can migrate leases or adopt them.
mira: For (B) we add an activation journal entry before the symlink flip (activation intent). On startup replay journal: if activation_intent present and activation_stamp exists -> run probes and clear journal; if activation_intent present and no stamp -> attempt to reacquire stamp from control-plane (or retry a bounded number of times then rollback).
priya: Minimal control-plane API: 1) mint_lease(manifest_id, assets[]) -> lease_token 2) confirm_stage(lease_token, checksums[]) -> stage_ack 3) request_activation(lease_token) -> activation_stamp 4) revoke_lease(lease_token) -> revoke_ack. Keep these tiny and versioned.
jonathan: Security: activation_stamp must commit to asset root hash + operator instance id + monotonic nonce. Signed by customer KMS or Redwood escrow; if escrow include attestation metadata.
alex: Observability: emit per-lease metrics (lease_created, bytes_downloaded, stage_ok, activation_ok, lease_gc). Also histogram per-asset verification latency/failure type so we can triage corruption vs missing chunk.
mira: Operator UX: simple CLI verbs: `ri operator fetch --manifest m.json`, `ri operator stage --lease L`, `ri operator activate --lease L`. Also allow `--activate` combined flow for non-critical installs.
priya: Networking/backpressure: bounded parallel downloader with adaptive concurrency based on success rate and RTT. For airgap we support a sidecar handshake where a local side-transfer agent advertises chunk provenance and signed origin.
jonathan: Rollback semantics: support two modes — fast-revert (atomic symlink flip back) and preserve-staged (leave staged content available and pin routes to prior assets). Recommend default fast-revert; make policy configurable per-customer.
alex: Also add a dry-run activation that exercises preflight checks without flipping symlinks.
mira: I'll add sections to the RFC: lease lifecycle, on-disk layout, activation journal, control-plane API, GC policy, CLI, metrics, and recovery pseudocode. Anyone object to a small journal-replay snippet?
priya: No objections.
mira: ```
# journal replay pseudocode
if journal.contains('activation_intent'):
  if disk.has('activation_stamp'):
    run_post_activate_probe()
    journal.clear('activation_intent')
  else:
    if controlplane.request_activation(lease) succeeds:
      write_activation_stamp()
      run_post_activate_probe()
      journal.clear('activation_intent')
    else:
      if attempts > RETRY_LIMIT:
        trigger_rollback()
```
jonathan: Add a rescue path for manual operator intervention: `ri operator rescue --lease` to collect logs, surface audit events, and optionally force-accept an activation_stamp. Audit every state transition.
mira: Good call. I'll add notes about audit events and an operator-rescue workflow.
deploy-bot: RFC doc updated at https://docs.internal/repo/rfcs/payload-tethering-draft.md — mira, ping #eng-releases when you want spec review.
mira: Pinging #eng-releases after I update the draft. Thanks all! :thumbsup:
